====Bare-handed planting====
'''Items required:''' ''Any [[seed]] ('''except''' grape seeds) that can be planted with a [[seed dibber]] (bring multiple in case you crush the first seed), 1 free [[Farming/Patch locations|Farming patch]].''
{{Checklist|
* Talk to [[Otto Godblessed]] and ask him about farming.{{Chat option|4How can I use my strength in the ways of agriculture?}}
* Go to the farming patch and plant the seed you have.
* Talk to Otto again and tell him of your success.{{Chat option|4I've planted seeds with my fists!}}
}}
